title: Latest reported figures: 1,259 confirmed dead
body: These figures are read automatically from the published reports as they appear, and are not written or checked by hand. confirmed dead: 1,259, up from 1,252, reported by Nepalnews. listed missing: 5,083, up from 4,875, reported by Nepalnews. rescued: 12,038, up from 11,993, reported by Nepalnews.
Where a report describes one district or one stretch of river rather than the national figure, it is not used here. Out of contact does not mean dead.
